d: Maragatham, a widow, tries to move on from the death of her husband. However, her life turns upside-down when her brother-in-law kicks her out of the house and later frames her for kidnapping.
Jeeva decides to protect Kala Devi who joins a circus company after her father's death as she inherits enormous wealth and has a threat to her life.
Durai's life takes a drastic turn after he revolts against Dharmalingam, Aalavandar and Punniyakodi, three corrupt politicians, when they try to defy the rules at a fair-price shop.
